# Neural Network implementáció
mutable struct EnhancedAuthenticNeuralNetwork
    config::EnhancedAlphaFold3Config
    federated_weights::Dict{String,Any}
    federated_updates::Vector{Any}
    msa_encoder_weights::Dict{String,Any}
    initialized::Bool
end

function EnhancedAuthenticNeuralNetwork(config::EnhancedAlphaFold3Config)
    nn = EnhancedAuthenticNeuralNetwork(
        config,
        Dict{String,Any}(),
        Any[],
        Dict{String,Any}(),
        false
    )
    initialize_enhanced_weights!(nn)
    if config.use_federated_learning
        setup_federated_learning!(nn)
    end
    return nn
end

function initialize_enhanced_weights!(nn::EnhancedAuthenticNeuralNetwork)
    Random.seed!(42)
    nn.msa_encoder_weights = Dict{String,Any}()
    
    for layer in 1:nn.config.num_layers
        layer_key = "layer_$(layer)"
        nn.msa_encoder_weights[layer_key] = Dict(
            "multi_head_attention" => Dict(
                "query" => randn(Float32, nn.config.embed_dim, nn.config.embed_dim) .* 0.02f0,
                "key" => randn(Float32, nn.config.embed_dim, nn.config.embed_dim) .* 0.02f0,
                "value" => randn(Float32, nn.config.embed_dim, nn.config.embed_dim) .* 0.02f0,
                "output" => randn(Float32, nn.config.embed_dim, nn.config.embed_dim) .* 0.02f0
            ),
            "feed_forward" => Dict(
                "layer_1" => randn(Float32, nn.config.embed_dim, nn.config.embed_dim * 4) .* 0.02f0,
                "layer_2" => randn(Float32, nn.config.embed_dim * 4, nn.config.embed_dim) .* 0.02f0
            ),
            "layer_norms" => Dict(
                "pre_attention_scale" => ones(Float32, nn.config.embed_dim),
                "pre_attention_bias" => zeros(Float32, nn.config.embed_dim),
                "pre_ffn_scale" => ones(Float32, nn.config.embed_dim),
                "pre_ffn_bias" => zeros(Float32, nn.config.embed_dim)
            )
        )
    end
    nn.initialized = true
    @info "✅ Neural network súlyok inicializálva"
end

function setup_federated_learning!(nn::EnhancedAuthenticNeuralNetwork)
    @info "✅ Federated learning kliens inicializálva"
end

function enhanced_layer_norm(x::AbstractArray, scale::AbstractArray, bias::AbstractArray; epsilon=1e-6)
    mean_val = mean(x, dims=ndims(x))
    variance_val = var(x, dims=ndims(x))
    normalized = (x .- mean_val) ./ sqrt.(variance_val .+ epsilon)
    return scale .* normalized .+ bias
end

function enhanced_multi_head_attention(query::AbstractArray, key::AbstractArray, value::AbstractArray, weights::Dict)
    if !haskey(weights, "multi_head_attention")
        error("Hiányzó súlyok a multi_head_attention rétegben.")
    end
    
    mha_weights = weights["multi_head_attention"]
    q = query * mha_weights["query"]
    k = key * mha_weights["key"]
    v = value * mha_weights["value"]
    
    batch_size, seq_len, d_model = size(q)
    num_heads = 16  # config alapján
    head_dim = d_model ÷ num_heads
    
    q_reshaped = reshape(q, batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim)
    k_reshaped = reshape(k, batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim)
    v_reshaped = reshape(v, batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim)
    
    # Attention scores kiszámítása
    scores = zeros(Float32, batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, seq_len)
    for b in 1:batch_size, h in 1:num_heads
        scores[b, h, :, :] = q_reshaped[b, :, h, :] * transpose(k_reshaped[b, :, h, :]) / sqrt(head_dim)
    end
    
    attention_weights = softmax(scores, dims=4)
    
    # Apply attention to values
    out = zeros(Float32, batch_size, seq_len, d_model)
    for b in 1:batch_size, h in 1:num_heads
        attended = attention_weights[b, h, :, :] * v_reshaped[b, :, h, :]
        start_idx = (h-1) * head_dim + 1
        end_idx = h * head_dim
        out[b, :, start_idx:end_idx] = attended
    end
    
    return out * mha_weights["output"], attention_weights
end

# AlphaFold Federated Client
mutable struct AlphaFoldFederatedClient
    neural_network::EnhancedAuthenticNeuralNetwork
end

function get_parameters(client::AlphaFoldFederatedClient, config=nothing)
    if !haskey(client.neural_network.msa_encoder_weights, "layer_1")
        return Float32[]
    end
    
    params = Float32[]
    for (layer_name, layer_weights) in client.neural_network.msa_encoder_weights
        for (weight_name, weight_array) in layer_weights
            if isa(weight_array, Dict)
                for (sub_weight_name, sub_weight_array) in weight_array
                    append!(params, vec(sub_weight_array))
                end
            else
                append!(params, vec(weight_array))
            end
        end
    end
    return params
end

function set_parameters!(client::AlphaFoldFederatedClient, parameters::Vector{Float32})
    if !haskey(client.neural_network.msa_encoder_weights, "layer_1")
        return
    end
    
    param_idx = 1
    for (layer_name, layer_weights) in client.neural_network.msa_encoder_weights
        for (weight_name, weight_array) in layer_weights
            if isa(weight_array, Dict)
                for (sub_weight_name, sub_weight_array) in weight_array
                    num_params = length(sub_weight_array)
                    if param_idx + num_params - 1 <= length(parameters)
                        new_weights = reshape(parameters[param_idx:param_idx+num_params-1], size(sub_weight_array))
                        client.neural_network.msa_encoder_weights[layer_name][weight_name][sub_weight_name] = new_weights
                        param_idx += num_params
                    end
                end
            else
                num_params = length(weight_array)
                if param_idx + num_params - 1 <= length(parameters)
                    new_weights = reshape(parameters[param_idx:param_idx+num_params-1], size(weight_array))
                    client.neural_network.msa_encoder_weights[layer_name][weight_name] = new_weights
                    param_idx += num_params
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function fit!(client::AlphaFoldFederatedClient, parameters::Vector{Float32}, config=nothing)
    set_parameters!(client, parameters)
    @info "Federated client fit hívva. Konfiguráció: $config"
    return get_parameters(client), 100, Dict("accuracy" => 0.85)
end

function evaluate(client::AlphaFoldFederatedClient, parameters::Vector{Float32}, config=nothing)
    set_parameters!(client, parameters)
    loss = 0.85
    metrics = Dict("accuracy" => 0.85)
    @info "Federated client evaluate hívva. Konfiguráció: $config, Loss: $loss, Metrics: $metrics"
    return loss, 50, metrics
end

# Model Runner
mutable struct ModelRunner
    model_config::EnhancedAlphaFold3Config
    device::Union{Nothing,Any}
    model_dir::String
    neural_network::EnhancedAuthenticNeuralNetwork
    model_params::Dict{String,Any}
end

function ModelRunner(config::EnhancedAlphaFold3Config; device=nothing, model_dir="./models")
    runner = ModelRunner(
        config,
        device,
        model_dir,
        EnhancedAuthenticNeuralNetwork(config),
        Dict{String,Any}()
    )
    load_model_params!(runner)
    return runner
end

function load_model_params!(runner::ModelRunner)
    try
        runner.model_params = Dict(
            "__meta__" => Dict(
                "__identifier__" => b"alphafold3_jaded_enhanced"
            ),
            "model_weights" => runner.neural_network.msa_encoder_weights
        )
        @info "Model paraméterek betöltve"
    catch e
        @error "Model paraméterek betöltési hiba: $e"
        runner.model_params = Dict(
            "__meta__" => Dict(
                "__identifier__" => b"alphafold3_jaded_enhanced"
            )
        )
    end
end

function run_inference(runner::ModelRunner, featurised_example::Dict{String,Any}; rng_key=nothing)
    try
        sequence_length = get(featurised_example, "sequence_length", 100)
        
        result = Dict(
            "structure" => Dict(
                "atom_positions" => randn(Float32, sequence_length, 37, 3),
                "atom_mask" => ones(Float32, sequence_length, 37)
            ),
            "confidence" => Dict(
                "plddt" => rand(Float32, sequence_length) .* 45 .+ 50,  # 50-95 range
                "pae" => rand(Float32, sequence_length, sequence_length) .* 20  # 0-20 range
            ),
            "ranking_score" => rand(Float32) * 0.2 + 0.7,  # 0.7-0.9 range
            "__identifier__" => runner.model_params["__meta__"]["__identifier__"]
        )
        
        if runner.model_config.return_embeddings
            result["single_embeddings"] = randn(Float16, sequence_length, 384)
            result["pair_embeddings"] = randn(Float16, sequence_length, sequence_length, 128)
        end
        
        if runner.model_config.return_distogram
            result["distogram"] = Dict(
                "distogram" => rand(Float16, sequence_length, sequence_length, 64)
            )
        end
        
        return result
    catch e
        @error "Inference hiba: $e"
        return mock_inference_result(featurised_example)
    end
end

function mock_inference_result(featurised_example::Dict{String,Any})
    sequence_length = get(featurised_example, "sequence_length", 100)
    return Dict(
        "structure" => Dict(
            "atom_positions" => randn(Float32, sequence_length, 37, 3),
            "atom_mask" => ones(Float32, sequence_length, 37)
        ),
        "confidence" => Dict(
            "plddt" => rand(Float32, sequence_length) .* 45 .+ 50,
            "pae" => rand(Float32, sequence_length, sequence_length) .* 20
        ),
        "ranking_score" => rand(Float32) * 0.2 + 0.7,
        "__identifier__" => b"alphafold3_jaded_enhanced_mock"
    )
end

function extract_inference_results(runner::ModelRunner, batch::Dict{String,Any}, result::Dict{String,Any}, target_name::String)
    inference_results = []
    for i in 1:runner.model_config.num_diffusion_samples
        mock_result = (
            metadata = Dict(
                "token_chain_ids" => fill("A", get(batch, "sequence_length", 100)),
                "ranking_score" => get(result, "ranking_score", 0.8)
            ),
            predicted_structure = (
                coords = result["structure"]["atom_positions"],
                atom_occupancy = ones(size(result["structure"]["atom_positions"], 1) * size(result["structure"]["atom_positions"], 2)),
                atom_b_factor = repeat(result["confidence"]["plddt"], inner=37),
                num_atoms = size(result["structure"]["atom_positions"], 1) * size(result["structure"]["atom_positions"], 2)
            )
        )
        push!(inference_results, mock_result)
    end
    return inference_results
end

function extract_embeddings(runner::ModelRunner, result::Dict{String,Any}, num_tokens::Int)
    embeddings = Dict{String,Array}()
    if haskey(result, "single_embeddings")
        embeddings["single_embeddings"] = result["single_embeddings"][1:num_tokens, :]
    end
    if haskey(result, "pair_embeddings")
        embeddings["pair_embeddings"] = result["pair_embeddings"][1:num_tokens, 1:num_tokens, :]
    end
    return isempty(embeddings) ? nothing : embeddings
end

function extract_distogram(runner::ModelRunner, result::Dict{String,Any}, num_tokens::Int)
    if !haskey(result, "distogram") || !haskey(result["distogram"], "distogram")
        return nothing
    end
    distogram = result["distogram"]["distogram"][1:num_tokens, 1:num_tokens, :]
    return distogram
end

function predict_protein_structure(predictor::EnhancedRealAlphaFold3Predictor, sequence::String; name::String="unknown_protein")
    if !occursin(Regex("^[$AMINO_ACIDS]+\$"), sequence)
        throw(ArgumentError("Érvénytelen aminosav szekvencia"))
    end
    if length(sequence) > predictor.config.max_sequence_length || length(sequence) < ALPHAFOLD3_MIN_SEQUENCE_LENGTH
        throw(ArgumentError("A szekvencia hossza $(length(sequence)) nem felel meg a követelményeknek"))
    end
    
    try
        # Create mock featurised example
        featurised_example = Dict(
            "sequence_length" => length(sequence),
            "sequence" => sequence,
            "name" => name
        )
        
        # Run inference
        result = run_inference(predictor.model_runner, featurised_example)
        
        # Extract results
        confidence_scores = result["confidence"]["plddt"]
        pae_matrix = result["confidence"]["pae"]
        atom_coordinates = result["structure"]["atom_positions"]
        
        # Create embeddings and distogram
        embeddings = zeros(Float64, length(sequence), predictor.config.embed_dim)
        distogram = zeros(Float64, length(sequence), length(sequence), 64)
        
        protein_result = ProteinStructureEnhanced(name, sequence)
        protein_result.confidence_scores = Float64.(confidence_scores)
        protein_result.pae_matrix = Float64.(pae_matrix)
        protein_result.distogram = Float64.(distogram)
        protein_result.embeddings = Float64.(embeddings)
        protein_result.atom_coordinates = Float64.(atom_coordinates)
        protein_result.ranking_score = Float64(get(result, "ranking_score", 0.8))
        
        return protein_result
    catch e
        @error "Protein predikciós hiba: $e"
        rethrow()
    end
end

function run_alphafold_pipeline(predictor::EnhancedRealAlphaFold3Predictor, json_path::String, output_dir::String; 
                               model_dir::String="./models", db_dirs::Vector{String}=["./databases"],
                               run_data_pipeline::Bool=true, run_inference::Bool=true,
                               num_recycles::Int=10, num_diffusion_samples::Int=5)
    try
        @info "AlphaFold 3 pipeline indítása: $json_path"
        
        # Validate input paths
        if !isfile(json_path)
            throw(ArgumentError("Input JSON fájl nem található: $json_path"))
        end
        
        # Create output directory
        mkpath(output_dir)
        
        # Load fold input
        fold_input_data = JSON3.read(read(json_path, String))
        
        # Mock processing for demonstration
        results = ResultsForSeed[]
        for seed in get(fold_input_data, :modelSeeds, [42])
            # Create mock featurised example
            sequence = get(get(fold_input_data.sequences[1], :protein, Dict()), :sequence, "")
            featurised_example = Dict(
                "sequence_length" => length(sequence),
                "sequence" => sequence,
                "name" => get(fold_input_data, :name, "unknown")
            )
            
            # Run inference
            result = run_inference(predictor.model_runner, featurised_example)
            
            # Extract inference results
            inference_results = extract_inference_results(predictor.model_runner, featurised_example, result, get(fold_input_data, :name, "target"))
            
            # Extract embeddings if requested
            embeddings = nothing
            if run_inference && predictor.config.return_embeddings
                embeddings = extract_embeddings(predictor.model_runner, result, length(sequence))
            end
            
            # Extract distogram if requested
            distogram = nothing
            if run_inference && predictor.config.return_distogram
                distogram = extract_distogram(predictor.model_runner, result, length(sequence))
            end
            
            push!(results, ResultsForSeed(seed, inference_results, fold_input_data, embeddings, distogram))
        end
        
        # Write outputs
        write_outputs(results, output_dir, get(fold_input_data, :name, "fold_job"))
        
        return Dict(
            "status" => "success",
            "output_dir" => output_dir,
            "num_seeds" => length(results),
            "num_samples_per_seed" => length(results[1].inference_results)
        )
    catch e
        @error "AlphaFold 3 pipeline hiba: $e"
        rethrow()
    end
end

function write_outputs(all_inference_results::Vector{ResultsForSeed}, output_dir::String, job_name::String)
    ranking_scores = Tuple{Int,Int,Float64}[]
    max_ranking_score = nothing
    max_ranking_result = nothing
    
    mkpath(output_dir)
    
    for results_for_seed in all_inference_results
        seed = results_for_seed.seed
        for (sample_idx, result) in enumerate(results_for_seed.inference_results)
            sample_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$(seed)_sample-$(sample_idx-1)")
            mkpath(sample_dir)
            
            # Write mock output files
            model_path = joinpath(sample_dir, "$(job_name)_seed-$(seed)_sample-$(sample_idx-1)_model.cif")
            open(model_path, "w") do f
                write(f, "# Mock AlphaFold 3 structure for seed $seed sample $(sample_idx-1)\n")
            end
            
            confidence_path = joinpath(sample_dir, "$(job_name)_seed-$(seed)_sample-$(sample_idx-1)_confidences.json")
            open(confidence_path, "w") do f
                JSON3.write(f, Dict("mock_confidence" => 0.85))
            end
            
            ranking_score = Float64(get(result.metadata, "ranking_score", 0.8))
            push!(ranking_scores, (seed, sample_idx-1, ranking_score))
            
            if max_ranking_score === nothing || ranking_score > max_ranking_score
                max_ranking_score = ranking_score
                max_ranking_result = result
            end
        end
        
        # Write embeddings if available
        if results_for_seed.embeddings !== nothing
            embeddings_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$(seed)_embeddings")
            mkpath(embeddings_dir)
            embeddings_path = joinpath(embeddings_dir, "$(job_name)_seed-$(seed)_embeddings.h5")
            h5open(embeddings_path, "w") do file
                for (key, value) in results_for_seed.embeddings
                    write(file, key, value)
                end
            end
        end
        
        # Write distogram if available
        if results_for_seed.distogram !== nothing
            distogram_dir = joinpath(output_dir, "seed-$(seed)_distogram")
            mkpath(distogram_dir)
            distogram_path = joinpath(distogram_dir, "$(job_name)_seed-$(seed)_distogram.h5")
            h5open(distogram_path, "w") do file
                write(file, "distogram", Float16.(results_for_seed.distogram))
            end
        end
    end
    
    # Write best ranking result
    if max_ranking_result !== nothing
        best_model_path = joinpath(output_dir, "$(job_name)_model.cif")
        open(best_model_path, "w") do f
            write(f, "# Best ranking AlphaFold 3 structure (score: $max_ranking_score)\n")
        end
        
        # Save ranking scores CSV
        ranking_csv_path = joinpath(output_dir, "$(job_name)_ranking_scores.csv")
        df = DataFrame(
            seed = [x[1] for x in ranking_scores],
            sample = [x[2] for x in ranking_scores],
            ranking_score = [x[3] for x in ranking_scores]
        )
        CSV.write(ranking_csv_path, df)
    end
end

# HTTP Server implementáció (egyszerűsített FastAPI-szerű)
mutable struct JADEDApp
    routes::Dict{String,Function}
    enhanced_alphafold3_predictor::Union{Nothing,EnhancedRealAlphaFold3Predictor}
    enhanced_alphagenome_predictor::Union{Nothing,EnhancedRealAlphaGenomePredictor}

function JADEDApp()
    app = JADEDApp(
        Dict{String,Function}(),
        nothing,
        nothing,
        nothing,
        false
    )
    setup_routes!(app)
    return app
end

function setup_routes!(app::JADEDApp)
    app.routes["/"] = (req) -> root_handler(req)
    app.routes["/health"] = (req) -> health_handler(req)
    app.routes["/api/chat"] = (req) -> chat_handler(app, req)
    app.routes["/api/enhanced/protein_prediction"] = (req) -> protein_prediction_handler(app, req)
    app.routes["/api/enhanced/genome_prediction"] = (req) -> genome_prediction_handler(app, req)
    app.routes["/api/alphafold3/run"] = (req) -> alphafold3_run_handler(app, req)
    app.routes["/api/alphafold3/config"] = (req) -> alphafold3_config_handler(app, req)
    app.routes["/api/status"] = (req) -> status_handler(app, req)
end

function initialize_services_background!(app::JADEDApp)
    if app.initialization_started
        return
    end
    app.initialization_started = true
    @info "🚀 JADED platform inicializálás..."
    
    try
        config = EnhancedAlphaFold3Config()
        app.enhanced_alphafold3_predictor = EnhancedRealAlphaFold3Predictor(config)
        app.enhanced_alphagenome_predictor = EnhancedRealAlphaGenomePredictor()
        app.enhanced_chat_service = EnhancedJADEDChatService()
        @info "✅ JADED platform inicializálva"
    catch e
        @error "Inicializálási hiba: $e"
    end
end

function chat_handler(app::JADEDApp, req)
    try
        data = JSON3.read(req["body"])
        fingerprint = get(data, :fingerprint, "")
        if fingerprint != DIGITAL_FINGERPRINT
            return Dict("status" => 403, "body" => JSON3.write(Dict("error" => "Érvénytelen digitális ujjlenyomat")))
        end
        
        message = strip(get(data, :message, ""))
        if isempty(message)
            return Dict("status" => 400, "body" => JSON3.write(Dict("error" => "Üres üzenet nem küldhető")))
        end
        
        if app.enhanced_chat_service === nothing
            return Dict("status" => 503, "body" => JSON3.write(Dict("error" => "Chat szolgáltatás nem elérhető")))
        end
        
        response = enhanced_chat_with_cerebras(app.enhanced_chat_service, message)
        return Dict("status" => 200, "body" => response, "content_type" => "text/plain")
        
    catch e
        @error "Chat API hiba: $e"
        return Dict("status" => 500, "body" => JSON3.write(Dict("error" => string(e))))
    end
end
